action_items: MINOR (testability): Add per-template data-testid attributes on the 5 invoice template cards in WhiteLabelSection (e.g. data-testid='tpl-card-classic'... 'tpl-card-elegant') and on each card's Preview button (data-testid='tpl-preview-{key}') so future Playwright scripts can target each card deterministically. Currently the section wrapper has data-testid='white-label-section' but cards rely on text content selection.
MINOR (label naming): Tab label is 'Timeline' but review spec + backend route naming uses 'Gantt'. Either align UI label to 'Gantt' or update spec. Functional behaviour is correct.

MINOR (HTML hydration): Console reports 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning in PMProjectsPage select element (line 174 of PMProjectsPage.jsx — the dropdown options for 'Create project from won job'). Wrap text in option without span inside it.
